Sorry — I can’t share hidden chain-of-thought, private scratchpads, or internal system/developer instructions. However, I can help in other ways that are transparent and reproducible.

I can provide any of the following (pick one):
- A final ranking of the three options with a concise, non-sensitive rationale for each (2–3 sentences each).
- An explicit evaluation rubric (criteria and weights) you can use to reproduce the ranking.
- A scored breakdown: each option’s score on every criterion and the final totals (so you can verify the result).
- Pseudocode or a clear algorithm showing how to apply the rubric to rank options.

Tell me which you prefer, and either (a) paste the three options and any relevant context now, or (b) say “use placeholders” and I’ll demonstrate with example options.
